Privacy Policy

Effective October 10, 2026

Cardograph is designed around a private personal collection. This policy explains how NABURA LABS LLC handles information when you use the Cardograph app, create an account, synchronize a collection, subscribe to Cardograph Plus, contact support, or use a Cardograph page that links here.

The short version. Camera frames stay on the phone and are not saved or uploaded. Signed in collection data synchronizes through Supabase. RevenueCat, Apple, or Google handles subscription status. Cardograph has no advertising and does not sell personal information or use it for cross context behavioral advertising.

Who we are

Cardograph is provided by NABURA LABS LLC. Contact essam@naburalabs.com with privacy questions or requests.

Information we handle

Account information

When you create or use an account, we can receive your email address, your name when Apple or Google supplies it and you choose to share it, provider identifiers, a Cardograph account identifier, and authentication session information. We do not receive your Apple or Google password. Authentication tokens are stored using secure storage supplied by the device platform.

Collection information

Your collection can include card identities, sets, numbers, languages, finishes, conditions, catalog identifiers, binder names and locations, wants, quantities, purchase costs, private notes, trade availability, trade partner labels, agreed values, cash amounts, activity history, binder audits, price references, and saved scan evidence. Scan evidence can include recognized text, matching reasons, timestamps, confidence values, and a matching fingerprint.

Avoid entering sensitive personal information about yourself or another person in binder names, notes, or trade partner fields.

Camera information

Cardograph uses the camera to detect card shaped regions and read visible text. Processing happens on the device. Cardograph does not record video, save camera photos, upload camera frames or corrected card crops, use the microphone, or require access to your photo library, contacts, or precise location. When you save a scan, limited text and matching evidence derived from it can become part of the collection record and can synchronize with the collection.

Subscription information

RevenueCat, Apple, or Google can provide the selected product, trial eligibility, purchase and renewal status, cancellation, expiration, refund, billing recovery information, access dates, store environment, and an app account identifier. Apple or Google processes the payment method. Cardograph and NABURA LABS LLC do not receive your complete payment card number.

Catalog, artwork, and price requests

Cardograph requests catalog records, artwork addresses, and reference prices from TCGdex. Requests can contain card identifiers and ordinary network information such as an internet protocol address. Cardograph does not send your complete collection, notes, account email, or subscription status to TCGdex.

Imports, exports, and support

Cardograph reads a CSV or JSON file only after you select it. An imported collection is stored on the device and, while signed in, can synchronize to the cloud. An export is passed to the device sharing interface, and the destination you choose is responsible for that copy.

If you contact us, we receive the information you send, including your email, message, and attachments. Do not send passwords, authentication links, complete payment card information, or information that is not needed for the request.

Operational information

Our providers can process ordinary operational information such as internet protocol addresses, request times, app version, device platform, service errors, and security events. Cardograph does not use this information to create advertising profiles or track activity across other companies' apps and websites.

How we use information

  • Create and protect accounts.
  • Save, synchronize, restore, import, and export collections.
  • Suggest card identities and display catalog and reference price information.
  • Process and verify subscription access and restore purchases.
  • Provide support, prevent abuse, protect the service, and comply with law.

Cardograph does not authenticate or grade cards, predict investment returns, or guarantee a sale price.

Service providers and disclosure

Supabase provides authentication, cloud database services, synchronization, and server functions. Signed in collection snapshots, account information, and subscription access records are processed through Supabase. See the Supabase Privacy Policy.

RevenueCat manages subscription products, trial eligibility, purchase status, restoration, and entitlement information. Cardograph uses the Cardograph account identifier as the RevenueCat app user identifier. See the RevenueCat Privacy Policy.

Apple and Google can provide sign in, distribution, purchase processing, subscription management, refunds, and platform services. See the Apple Privacy Policy and Google Privacy Policy.

TCGdex provides card catalog records, artwork addresses, and market price references.

We can disclose information when reasonably necessary to comply with law, respond to valid legal process, investigate fraud or abuse, protect users, protect our rights, or address a security issue. If Cardograph or NABURA LABS LLC is involved in a merger, financing, acquisition, reorganization, or sale of assets, information can transfer as part of that transaction. We do not sell personal information or share it for cross context behavioral advertising.

Storage and security

Collection information is stored in the Cardograph app area on the device. Public catalog and price information can be cached for offline use. A signed in collection automatically synchronizes with Supabase and can include notes, costs, trades, binder information, and scan evidence.

Cloud connections use HTTPS and authentication tokens use platform secure storage. Cloud collection snapshots are not end to end encrypted, which means our cloud provider must be able to process them to operate the service. No storage or transmission method is completely secure.

Retention

Local information remains until you erase it, delete the related account data from that device, or uninstall Cardograph. Device backups can retain an app copy according to your settings. Cloud collection information remains while the account is active and until you delete the account or ask us to delete applicable information.

An expired or canceled subscription does not automatically delete a collection. Account deletion removes the active Cardograph account, its cloud collection, and its RevenueCat customer profile. Apple and Google retain store purchase records according to their own requirements. Other offline devices can retain copies until those copies are erased on each device.

We can retain a minimal deletion record needed to honor deletion, security and service logs for a reasonable period, records required for legal compliance or fraud prevention, and residual provider backups until their ordinary backup cycle removes them. Support messages are kept only as long as reasonably needed for support, security, disputes, or legal requirements.

Your choices and rights

  • Deny or remove camera permission in device settings.
  • Review and correct collection information.
  • Export collection information as CSV or JSON.
  • Erase the selected collection from the current phone.
  • Delete the Cardograph account and cloud collection in the app.
  • Cancel a subscription through Apple or Google.
  • Ask for access, correction, deletion, or a portable copy by emailing essam@naburalabs.com, where applicable.

We may need to verify identity before completing a request. Depending on where you live, law can provide additional rights concerning access, correction, deletion, portability, restriction, or appeal. We will not discriminate against you for exercising an applicable privacy right.

Children

Cardograph is not directed to children under 13, and children under 13 must not create an account or use the service. A person under the age of legal majority where they live should use Cardograph only with permission from a parent or legal guardian. Contact us if you believe a child under 13 provided personal information.

Processing locations

NABURA LABS LLC is based in the United States. Our providers can process information in the United States and other countries where they operate, which can have different data protection laws.

Changes

We can update this policy as Cardograph, its providers, or applicable requirements change. We will update the effective date and provide additional notice when a material change requires it.
